outline:
先修課程:負責教授同意學生與教授討論擬定專題研究的題目，在教授的個別指導下，進行實驗研究，並將研究結果寫成報告。四技修三學期，而在每一學期修完時如欲換題目時需等老師將該學期成績打出後再徵求原來及新老師都同意才可更換題目。
The course is based on 16 + 2 weeks of flexible learning.

flexible_learning.content:
Weeks 17 & 18 are scheduled as flexible independent learning. You will work with your group, use what you learned this semester, and combine it with an AI tool to solve a problem.
1.	Work with your group
2.	Use AI to solve the problem
3.	Write your report
4.      Everyone turns in their own report to the e-Learning system.
flexible_learning.outcome:
The goal is to understand the course content. Students may use an AI tool to solve the problem and gain a comprehensive understanding of the problem while learning through the exercise.

Each individual must submit their own report. No report, no points.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:
Weeks 17 & 18 Report: 7%

Each individual must turn in their own report. No report, no points.
